content: Autoclave tape is a specialized adhesive tape designed for use in autoclaving processes to confirm that the appropriate sterilization temperature has been achieved. Small strips of this tape are affixed to items prior to their placement in the autoclave. The tape resembles masking tape but is formulated to be more adhesive, enabling it to remain securely attached under the high-temperature and high-humidity conditions present during autoclaving. The tape is marked with diagonal patterns that contain a heat-sensitive ink. This ink undergoes a color change, usually transitioning from beige to black, when exposed to the required sterilization temperature. One example of such an ink formulation includes 30.1% lead thiosulfate, 0.6% magnesium carbonate, 20.1% neocryl B8141, 30.1% ethanol, 22.7% ethyl acetate, and 49% ink solids.
